title: Worksheet 11: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are both wireless technologies that let devices communicate without physical cables, but they are designed for different purposes. Wi-Fi is typically used to connect a device, like a laptop or phone, to the internet through a router, and it can transmit data over a relatively long range, often covering an entire house or building. Bluetooth, on the other hand, is designed for short-range connections directly between two nearby devices, such as connecting wireless headphones to a phone or a wireless mouse to a computer, usually working within about 30 feet. Bluetooth generally uses less battery power than Wi-Fi, which is one reason it is commonly used for small, battery-powered accessories. While Wi-Fi usually requires a router or access point to work, Bluetooth devices can typically connect directly to each other without any additional equipment, in a process often called "pairing."
